Definition: hence, an acre (i.e. day's task for a yoke of cattle to plough)
BiblicalUsage: tsemed is the ordinary word for a yoke of oxen; the land a yoke ploughs in a day. It appears 15 times in Scripture, including 1 Samuel 14:14 and Isaiah 5:10.
TheologicalSignificance: I hold that tsemed is one of the small details that matter in Scripture.
